usage: tunnel record [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] {start,stop,status} ...

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,status}
    start              keep every passthrough call from here on
    stop               stop recording; what is on disk stays
    status             whether recording is on, and how much is recorded

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --base BASE          where the admin API answers (default
                       http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json               print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
